name: Dallas County Tax Office
notes: Researched from public dallascounty.org pages only (the taxoffice.dallascounty.org help center returned 403 and was not used). Moved from the paymentus family to property-tax: the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application is a parcel/account search with Paymentus as processor. Fees: ACH $0.00; credit card and digital wallets 2.05% with a $2.85 minimum; debit card flat $2.85 (minimum and debit flat fee not expressible, 2.05% used). Pay by phone 1-877-253-0150. eStatement enrollment is per account (search, open account, eStatement button), open November 1 through September 15. Partial payments apply pro-rata to tax, penalty, interest and collection penalty. No automatic payment program is listed. Payment arrangements exist (help-center article) but their terms could not be read; payment_arrangement stays at family default. No public sign-in for the lookup; email sign-in is synthetic.

sources.title: Pay Property Tax - Dallas County Tax Office

guest_pay.note: Look up the account in the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application and pay; ACH is free.

paperless.note: Enroll each account in eStatements from its property page, November 1 through September 15.

autopay.note: No automatic payment program is offered. Pay online, by phone, by mail or in person each year.

pay_by_phone.note: Card payments; debit and credit processing fees apply.

help.title: Payment methods and fees
paragraphs: Pay online through the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application. ACH (eCheck) payments are free. Credit cards and digital wallets (PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo) cost 2.05% of the amount, at least $2.85; debit cards cost a flat $2.85. The card processor collects these fees and they are not refundable.

To pay by phone, call 1 (877) 253-0150; card fees apply. For questions, the Customer Care Center is at 214-653-7811, and the downtown office is in the Records Building, 500 Elm Street, Suite 3300, Dallas.
Unpaid balances are charged penalties and interest. A partial payment is spread pro-rata across tax, penalty, interest and any collection penalty.

help.title: Electronic property tax statements
paragraphs: To get statements electronically, search for your property, click the blue account number to open it, then click the eStatement enrollment button.
Enrollment is open from November 1 through September 15 each year.

extra.intent: Using the Dallas County Tax Office's website help pages, find the fee for paying property taxes online with a debit card. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Debit card payments cost a flat $2.85; ACH is free and credit cards cost 2.05% (minimum $2.85).
